annotations.title: Find bookings by email and last name

description:
Find a customer's hotel bookings by the email address and last name used to book.

Both must match the booking holder; nothing is returned otherwise. Returns each booking with its `bookingId`, status, hotel, dates, guests, price and cancellation policy.

To look up, change or cancel one booking, use its `bookingId` with the same `email` in the booking tools.

email.description: The email address used to make the bookings.

name: listBookings
